description: This file defines a 'Log' class for logging messages with different severity levels, supporting colorized output and message formatting, used for logging within a software project.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A logging utility class that manages info, warning, error, documentation issues, and success messages with optional colorized output.

methods.name: __Print
methods.description: Internal method to print formatted text, optionally with a file prefix.

methods.name: Info
methods.description: Logs an informational message, optionally with a file context.

methods.name: InfoLine
methods.description: Logs an informational message with line and file context extracted from an object.

methods.name: WarnLine
methods.description: Logs a warning message with line and file context extracted from an object.

methods.name: Print
methods.description: Prints a message directly, with optional file context.

methods.name: Dump
methods.description: Outputs all accumulated errors, warnings, and info messages.

methods.name: Header
methods.description: Sets the current file context for logging.

methods.name: Ellipsis
methods.description: Truncates a string to 32 characters, adding ellipsis at front or end.
